source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: ليلة شتوية باردة، كنا قاعدين حوالي الصوبا.
sentences.en: One cold winter night, we were sitting around the heater.
Suddenly, we heard a knock on the door.

sentences.ar: أبوي فتح، ولقى رجال غريب مبلول من الشتا.
sentences.en: My dad opened, and found a strange man soaked from the rain.

sentences.ar: الرجال قال: سيارتي وقفت بالطريق، وأنا تايه.
sentences.en: The man said: my car broke down on the road, and I'm lost.

sentences.ar: أبوي قاله على طول: تفضل، البيت بيتك.
sentences.en: My dad said to him right away: come in, my house is your house.

sentences.ar: قعدناه جنب الصوبا وجبناله أواعي ناشفة.
sentences.en: We seated him by the heater and brought him dry clothes.
My mom heated soup and served him dinner.

sentences.ar: الرجال قال: ما بعرف كيف أشكركم.
sentences.en: The man said: I don't know how to thank you.

sentences.ar: أبوي رد: هاي واجب، وإحنا بنكرم الضيف.
sentences.en: My dad replied: this is a duty, and we honor the guest.

sentences.ar: سهرنا معه وحكالنا عن حياته وسفراته.
sentences.en: We stayed up with him and he told us about his life and travels.
In the morning, the sun came out and the rain stopped.
My dad helped him fix his car.

sentences.ar: قبل ما يمشي، الرجال قال: مش رح أنساكم أبدا.
sentences.en: Before he left, the man said: I will never forget you.

sentences.ar: بعد شهر، وصلنا هدية كبيرة وورقة مكتوب فيها شكرا.
sentences.en: After a month, a big gift arrived with a note saying thank you.

sentences.ar: أبوي قال: الخير اللي بتعمله، بيرجعلك.
sentences.en: My dad said: the good you do comes back to you.

sentences.ar: من هديك الليلة، تعلمت شو يعني الكرم.
sentences.en: From that night, I learned what generosity means.
